caption: The drawing depicts two views of a ceramic jug featuring a sculpted human face on its body. The jug is rendered in shades of brown with lighter, almost golden highlights that suggest a glazed surface. The front view (left) shows the jug with a pronounced nose, wide circular eyes with prominent rims, and a mouth displaying a row of vertical, tooth-like shapes. The jug has a short neck and a small, slightly domed lid. The side view (right) highlights the jug's ear on the left side of the face and a large handle attached from the neck to the upper body of the jug, curving outward. The facial features, including the nose and lips, are sculpted in relief, and the circular eye is prominent in profile. The jug is outlined with a darker line, and the drawing itself is framed by a thin faded border within the image. The overall composition shows careful attention to the three-dimensional qualities and texture of the jug.
title: Grotesque Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
